name: Weather Icon
description: Eleven animated weather symbols drawn as lines on a 24 grid, each with its own small, slow loop.

props.name: kind
props.description: The symbol. Each has a loop: rays pulse in turn, cloud edges breathe, rain falls in sequence, flakes drift and turn, fog bands shift, gusts slide through the wind lines, lightning flickers, stars twinkle.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. Strokes are 1.5 units of the 24 grid, so they scale with the size.

props.name: animate
props.description: When the loop plays. Hover plays it only while the pointer is over the icon. Every kind rests on a complete still frame, which is also what reduced motion shows.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, such as "Heavy snow". Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the svg. Lines are currentColor. The sun and lightning use --miyuki-weather-icon-sun (yuzu by default) and rain and snow use --miyuki-weather-icon-water (water by default); set either on the icon or a parent. Other svg props are passed through.
